summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing an extract from the minutes of its ordinary Board of Directors meeting held on July 30, 2026. The board approved amendments to the internal regulations of the Nomination and Governance Committee, ratified the nomination of Wilfred Theodoor Bruijn as Lead Independent Director effective August 1, 2026, and elected Reinaldo Duarte Castanheira Filho as Vice-Chairman of the Board. One director (MG) abstained citing potential conflict. These are routine corporate governance actions, not special-situation events. No M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special category applies.
